River-mile note: Whole-mile and tenth-mile references in this prototype are interpolated along the 2025 survey route between the upstream and downstream Indiana DNR mile range. They are intended for visual navigation; the observation latitude and longitude remain authoritative.
EarthViews preview: Clicking a point attempts to load the matching public tour location in the preview panel. If the EarthViews server blocks embedded display, use the live “Open EarthViews” link.

Observation categories can overlap; one record may contribute to multiple bars. Keyword searches update the map and both charts. Optional interpretations are generated locally from the displayed counts. The Excel export contains the active filtered observations, chart counts, and a selection summary. A two-page PDF report with a map image, representative EarthViews links, and a dashboard exploration link is available when a specific Observation Type is selected. A local text synthesis appears when a specific observation type is selected or a keyword or phrase is entered. Previous and Next controls step through the currently filtered observations. Version 16.1 identifies the original GoPro MAX 360° source file, exact time within that recording, and a suggested 20-second editing window.
